motion.div app $: let completed = {workouts.filter(w => w.done).length} $: let total = {workouts.length} h1 heading "{title}" div stats span "Completed {completed}/{total}" for workout in {workouts} div card data-id={workout.id} div row span name "{workout.name}" if {workout.done} span badge green "Done" else span badge yellow "Pending" button primary type="button" data-action="toggle" data-id={workout.id} "Toggle" match {completed === total} true => div success "All workouts completed." _ => div notice "Keep going." { "title": "Weekly Workout Tracker", "workouts": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Push Day", "done": true }, { "id": 2, "name": "Pull Day", "done": false }, { "id": 3, "name": "Leg Day", "done": false } ] } document.addEventListener("click", (e) => { const btn = e.target.closest("[data-action='toggle']"); if (!btn) return; const id = Number(btn.dataset.id); console.log("toggle workout", id); });
